                    Filter(

                    Trim(Self.SearchText),
                    'Display Name',

                    Mail

                'Display Name',
                DisplayName,
                Mail,
                EMail
            ),
            UniqueKey,
            'A unique identifer for Microsoft Entra ID'
        )
    )
);

With(
    {
        locFilteredDetailsList: ForAll(
            AddColumns(
                colFilteredProjects,
                loc_iconstate,
                "loc_iconcolor",
                loc_iconview,
                "loc_iconedit"
            ),
            {
                vsb_projectid: ThisRecord.Project,
                vsb_name: ThisRecord.'Internal Project ID',
                vsb_projectname: ThisRecord.'Project Name',
                vsb_shortname: ThisRecord.'Short Name',
                vsb_projectmanager: If(
                    IsBlank(ThisRecord.'Project Manager'),
                    "",
                    ThisRecord.'Project Manager'.'Display Name'
                ),
                vsb_projectstate: ThisRecord.'Cluster State'.Name,
                vsb_country: ThisRecord.Country.Name,
                vsb_countryarea: ThisRecord.'Area/State/Province'.Name,
                vsb_technology: ThisRecord.Technology,
                vsb_capacitymwwtg: Text(
                    ThisRecord.'Total Capacity',
                    "#,##0.0#"
                ),
                vsb_numberwtgs: 0,
                loc_wMW: ThisRecord.WeightedMW,
                vsb_projectstartdate: If(
                    IsBlank(ThisRecord.'Project Start Date'),
                    "",
                    Text(
                        DateValue(ThisRecord.'Project Start Date'),
                        "dd.mm.yyyy"
                    )
                ),
                vsb_feasibilitystudies: If(
                    IsBlank(ThisRecord.'1-Feasibility studies'),
                    "",
                    Text(
                        DateValue(ThisRecord.'1-Feasibility studies'),
                        "dd.mm.yyyy"
                    )
                ),
                vsb_projectdevelopmentstarted: If(
                    IsBlank(ThisRecord.'2-Project development started'),
                    "",
                    Text(
                        DateValue(ThisRecord.'2-Project development started'),
                        "dd.mm.yyyy"
                    )
                ),
                vsb_applicationsubmitted: If(
                    IsBlank(ThisRecord.'3-Application submitted'),
                    "",
                    Text(
                        DateValue(ThisRecord.'3-Application submitted'),
                        "dd.mm.yyyy"

Rules.InvariantScript:
With(
    {
        varProjectRecord: LookUp(
            Projects,
            ThisRecord.Project = GUID(psf_MainScreen_DetailList_Container_FluentDetailsList.Selected.vsb_projectid)
        )
    },
    If(
        And(
            IsBlank(varProjectRecord.'Project ID'),
            IsBlank(varProjectRecord.'Project Start Date'),
            Or(
                varProjectRecord.'Total Capacity' = 0,
                IsBlank(varProjectRecord.'Total Capacity')
            ),
            Or(
                varProjectRecord.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
                IsBlank(varProjectRecord.'Net Yield p50')
            ),
            varProjectRecord.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft"
        ),
        lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_45.Height * 7,
        IsBlank(varProjectRecord.'Project Start Date'),
        lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_45.Height * 6,
        Or(
            varProjectRecord.'Total Capacity' = 0,
            IsBlank(varProjectRecord.'Total Capacity')
        ),
    // else / default height when none of the above conditions are true
        lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_45.Height * 5,
        Or(
            varProjectRecord.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
            IsBlank(varProjectRecord.'Net Yield p50')
        ),
        lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_45.Height * 4,
        varProjectRecord.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft",
        lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_45.Height * 3,
        lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_45.Height
    )
)
